Name: Simple Insignia - Companion Annabelle - Bounty And Contracts
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]✦ Simple Insignia ✦[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]PC 1.67[/b] main download • [b]Android 1.16[/b] optional download. Single-player only.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Meet [b]Annabelle[/b], a playful purple-haired apparition companion. Build a friendship, hear her observations about the Valley, and earn rewards through daily adventures, weekly challenges and seasonal milestones.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]HD dialogue portraits:[/b] Annabelle now uses full HD expression cells in normal NPC dialogue at the correct size. The Classic portrait option in Generic Mod Config Menu selects the classic artwork. Keep the original portrait filenames; no manual renaming is needed.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Localized name:[/b] Her Social-tab, profile and text name labels follow your game language, including 安娜贝尔 in Chinese. Existing friendship, gift history and saved companion progress are preserved.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]HD profile sprite:[/b] Annabelle’s Social profile now draws her full detailed sprite sheet instead of enlarging the low-resolution compatibility frame. Her size, position and turning animation are preserved. The Use standard sprite option remains available.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]💜 A Companion with Personality[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Annabelle follows you or roams nearby, with comments about your activities, surroundings, time and weather. Her playful royal attitude mixes teasing with warmer, more vulnerable moments as your friendship grows.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]277 additional dialogue lines[/b] add more villager observations, everyday remarks, wildlife sightings and reactions after supported cutscenes and festival outcomes. She needs to witness the relevant situation; skipped scenes and every passing action do not automatically produce a comment.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]After a completed conversation, she can comment about that NPC, with at most one automatic reaction per NPC each day. Relevant dialogue rotates before repeating, and delivered-line history survives saving and reloading. Recognised villagers and supported Stardew Valley Expanded/Ridgeside characters have specific remarks; unfamiliar NPCs have a named fallback.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]World speech bubbles and optional menu chatter keep her company alongside your normal play. Adjust chatter categories, timing and reading time in Generic Mod Config Menu.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53823/53823-1791947206-1321030470.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]🌸 Friendship, Gifts and Stories[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Talk to Annabelle, offer gifts and choose outfits or her floating Spirit form. Five friendship events unlock at [b]2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 hearts[/b], with no follow-up chore requirements. Her birthday is [b]Fall 27[/b], when gifts apply an [b]8× friendship multiplier[/b]. Event staging remains a work in progress.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Her updated movement sprite is enabled by default. Choose [b]Use standard sprite[/b] in Generic Mod Config Menu or Wardrobe for the fallback. An optional [b]Classic portrait[/b] setting is also available in Generic Mod Config Menu. Nesquik Powder and Hot Chocolate Nesquik have special gift reactions; her two-heart letter teaches the drink recipe and unlocks powder at Pierre’s.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📜 Bounties & Contracts[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Three daily adventures[/b] track farming, fishing, foraging, mining and combat. Complete the goals for gold and skill XP; you keep the items you gather.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53823/53823-1791941476-1932531696.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Weekly challenges[/b] cover Farming, Fishing, Foraging, Mining, Combat and Living, with eligible catch-up challenges and limited refreshes. [b]Seasonal milestones[/b] offer ten reward tiers for each of the five work skills, trophies and a past-season archive.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53823/53823-1791941492-469780231.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]📍 Getting Started[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]1. Visit Old Master Cannoli’s statue in the Secret Woods and interact with it. Close its normal dialogue to begin Annabelle’s introduction. The entrance opens by default; an optional setting keeps the vanilla log requirement.
2. Complete her introduction to receive the Insignia. Open it with [b]K[/b] or the button on the normal backpack Inventory tab. Android uses the backpack shortcut.
3. Complete the introductory sample: catch five fish with a rod for [b]100g + 50 Fishing XP[/b]. They do not need to be different species. Claim the sample reward manually; the journal explains when regular activities begin.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]🎁 Annabelle’s Gift Tastes[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Loved:[/b] flower-category gifts; Chocolate Cake, Pink Cake, Rhubarb Pie, Cookie, Ice Cream, Blueberry Tart, Plum Pudding, Pumpkin Pie, Blackberry Cobbler, regular Milk, Nesquik Powder and Hot Chocolate Nesquik.
[b]Liked:[/b] fruit and vegetables, except the explicit dislikes below.
[b]Neutral:[/b] Coffee, Triple Shot Espresso, Green Tea and Tea Leaves. Other unmatched eligible gifts are neutral, including unclassified modded items.
[b]Disliked:[/b] raw fish, bait, Seaweed, Green Algae, White Algae, Bug Meat, Beer, Pale Ale, Mead, Wine, Garlic, Wild Horseradish and Void Mayonnaise.
[b]Hated:[/b] Trash, Driftwood, Broken Glasses, Broken CD, Soggy Newspaper, Slime, Bat Wing, Solar Essence, Void Essence, Red Mushroom and Holly, plus other junk/monster-loot-category items. Bug Meat is an explicit dislike exception.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Specific exceptions override broad categories. Base friendship: loved +80, liked +45, neutral +20, disliked −20, hated −40. Quality improves positive values; birthdays multiply gains and losses by eight. Normal gift limits are one per day and two per week. After her introduction, Annabelle appears in the Social tab with her hearts, gift counts and conversation status. Her profile records newly given gifts using these same tastes.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌍 Languages[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Interface text and dialogue, including the new ambient, NPC, wildlife and event lines, support English, Chinese, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Spanish and Turkish. The mod follows your game language. Translations are AI-assisted; native-speaker feedback is welcome.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🛠 Requirements & Installation[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]PC:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0+[/url].
[b]Android:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6.15.3 with a compatible Android SMAPI port exposing API 4.3.2+. The journal needs at least 800×480 effective UI space; lower UI scale if prompted.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53536]Simple Town Chatter[/url] are optional.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Install [b]one platform file[/b], extract its mod folder into Mods, and launch through SMAPI. For updates, close the game, back up your save, retain config.json and replace the mod’s runtime files. Do not install this combined edition alongside [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54016]Simple Insignia - Annabelle[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54017]Simple Insignia - Bounties and Contracts[/url]; choose the combined edition or the separate mods.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]🎨 Sprite Artists Welcome![/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]If you create Stardew Valley sprites and would like to help with Annabelle’s sprite or animations, you’re welcome to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Xsyy]message me[/url]. I’d really appreciate it! :D[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Found a bug or have an idea? Leave it on this mod’s page. For bugs, include the mod version, game/SMAPI versions and platform, what happened versus what you expected, steps to reproduce, a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url], and a screenshot or short video if helpful. For suggestions, explain what you would change and how it would improve the mod.[/color][/size][/center]
